mapper.select: SELECT A.BASIC_CODE AS basicCode, A.BASIC_GROUP_NM AS basicGroupNm, A.BASIC_GROUP_CNT AS basicGroupCnt, A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM AS frstRegistPnttm, A.FRST_REGISTER_ID AS frstRegisterId, A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM AS lastUpdtPnttm, A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID AS lastUpdusrId FROM TB_BRODBASICGROUP A WHERE A.BASIC_CODE = #{basicCode}

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_BRODBASICGROUP A WHERE 1=1
AND A.BASIC_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{BASIC_CODE}, '%')
AND A.BASIC_GROUP_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{basicGroupNm}, '%')
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_BRODBASICGROUP SET BASIC_GROUP_CNT = ( SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_BASICSCHEDULE B WHERE B.BASIC_CODE = TB_BRODBASICGROUP.BASIC_CODE )
